capabilities: Transcribe microphone speech in real time
Run local SenseVoice or managed cloud recognition
Apply hotwords and wrong => correct rules
Translate, polish, and summarize transcripts via AI
Export transcripts to Markdown notes with history
disambiguation: Not a general audio recorder; it transcribes microphone speech to text and exports notes, with optional AI post-processing.
extras: Local mode needs about 240 MB of model files and a Python 3.10-3.12 environment; cloud mode sends audio to Tencent Cloud (mainland China) or Deepgram Nova-3 (overseas). AI features can use OpenAI-compatible APIs or Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode CLIs. data.json may contain API keys and should not be shared.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record and transcribe speech, so turning spoken notes into text requires external tools and manual copying.

requires.name: Managed cloud ASR account (Tencent Cloud or Deepgram)
OpenAI-compatible API key for translation, polishing, summaries
Cloud ASR and AI API usage

summary: Real-time speech-to-text plugin using local SenseVoice or cloud ASR, with hotwords, corrections, translation, polishing, and summaries.
